name: Two-spot Ladybird
desc: Two-spot Ladybird (Adalia bipunctata): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Adalia bipunctata, the two-spot ladybird, two-spotted ladybug or two-spotted lady beetle, is a carnivorous beetle of the family Coccinellidae that is found throughout the holarctic region.
